author: thegames
quote:
We play GTA because it lets us do whatever we want — kill anyone, mess around, cause chaos, and enjoy the freedom to experiment with all kinds of crazy and creative things.

GTA has always been different from other games because it never held back when it came to player freedom. It let us use our weapons, shoot whoever we wanted, and create absolute chaos without constantly restricting our choices.

That's part of the appeal. We can't do these things in real life, and for many players, GTA is a way to escape reality, blow off some steam, and have fun without consequences.

But unfortunately, it feels like Rockstar has forgotten what made GTA so special in the first place. And honestly, that's disappointing.
